partner: DSC2 extracellular + DSG2 extracellular cadherin context
evidence_summary: DSC2 and DSG2 are core desmosomal cadherins. Local evidence includes direct pair support and shared desmosome context; prior full-length DSG2-DSC2 was weak, so compact ectodomain rescue is preferred.
support_sources: UniProt Q02487; UniProt Q14126; IntAct EBI-1103439/EBI-2556545/EBI-3048545/EBI-6900677/EBI-6900770/EBI-6901331; PubMed 21062920; Reactome R-HSA-6805567/R-HSA-6809371; local AF3_PILOTV2_019_DSG2_DSC2
caveat: Cadherin interactions can depend on Ca2+, glycosylation, membrane orientation, and desmosome architecture.

evidence_summary: DSC2-PKP2 has direct UniProt/IntAct evidence and PKP2 is a core cardiac desmosomal plaque protein.
caveat: Tail/plaque interaction may need membrane orientation and higher-order desmosome assembly.

evidence_summary: DSC2 interacts with JUP in curated subunit text, and JUP is a central desmosomal plaque protein relevant to arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.
support_sources: UniProt Q02487; UniProt P14923; PubMed 21062920; PubMed 11790773; PubMed 22781308; Reactome R-HSA-6805567/R-HSA-6809371
caveat: May need PKP2/DSP context; interpret only if pairwise interface QC is strong.

evidence_summary: DSC2 has curated DSP interaction context, but full DSP is large and DSP plaque contexts are covered in DSP/PKP2 packets.
support_sources: UniProt Q02487; UniProt P15924; PubMed 21062920; PubMed 16917092; PubMed 25225338
caveat: Potential later sensitivity job using DSP N-terminal 1-584 if DSC2-tail jobs are promising.

evidence_summary: Full-length DSG2-DSC2 was already submitted in pilot-v2 and was not interface-usable.
Some broader junctional or by-similarity candidates exist, but they are not stronger than core DSC2 desmosomal partners.
